controles.affirmation: LGC Holdco detient 34,52% des actions de categorie B au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "LGC Holdco beneficially owns less than one percent of the Company's outstanding Class A Common Stock and approximately 34.52% of the Company's Class B Common Stock as of June 30, 2026."

controles.affirmation: Un accord d'actionnaires avec Fox Corporation plafonne la concentration a 44% des voix de categorie B
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "The Company has entered into a stockholders agreement with LGC Holdco and the LGC Family Trusts pursuant to which the parties have agreed not to take actions that would result in LGC Holdco and the LGC Family Trusts owning, collectively with [...] the 'Murdoch Individuals', more than 44% of the outstanding voting power of the shares of Class B Common Stock" ; "On September 8, 2025, the Company entered into a new stockholders agreement (the 'New Stockholders Agreement') with LGC Holdco, LLC and certain Murdoch family trusts"
controles.correction_proposee: Le plafond de 44% resulte d'un accord entre News Corp et LGC Holdco / les LGC Family Trusts, signe le 8 septembre 2025, et non d'un accord avec Fox Corporation. Fox n'apparait dans le 10-K qu'au titre des conflits d'interets d'administrateurs et de l'indemnisation des affaires de presse britanniques. Corriger les deux occurrences (bloc fondamental_interne et bloc quantitatif).

controles.affirmation: News Corp indique que le programme de rachat a augmente et pourrait continuer d'augmenter la part de categorie B detenue par LGC Holdco
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "The Company's Board of Directors has authorized a $1 billion stock repurchase program for the Company's Class A and Class B Common Stock, which has increased and could in the future further increase the percentage of Class B Common Stock held by LGC Holdco."

controles.affirmation: Le programme de rachat de 1 Md$ s'est acheve sur l'exercice 2026 (et, dans ce_qui_affaiblirait, un nouveau programme pourrait etre annonce)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "the '2021 Repurchase Program', which was completed during the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026" ; "the Company announced a new stock repurchase program authorizing the Company to purchase up to $1 billion [...] (the '2025 Repurchase Program')" ; "As of June 30, 2026, there was no authorized amount remaining under the 2021 Repurchase Program, and the remaining authorized amount under the 2025 Repurchase Program was approximately $667 million."
controles.correction_proposee: Presenter le rachat comme un episode clos est trompeur : un second programme de 1 Md$ (2025 Repurchase Program) est deja en cours avec environ 667 M$ d'autorisation restante au 30 juin 2026, sans limite de duree. L'item de ce_qui_affaiblirait "Un nouveau programme de rachat est annonce" est donc deja realise. Reformuler en mentionnant le programme 2025 et son solde.

controles.affirmation: EBITDA News Media -9% a 139 M$ vs 153 M$, Book Publishing -3% a 287 M$ vs 296 M$, les deux segments pesant 4 515 M$ sur 9 028 M$
EBITDA Dow Jones +13%, immobilier numerique +23%, resultat net des activites poursuivies +15%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : Dow Jones 663 vs 588 (+12,8%), Digital Real Estate Services 741 vs 601 (+23,3%) ; "Net income from continuing operations $743 $648" (+14,7%)

controles.affirmation: Des changements d'algorithmes des plateformes tierces ont deja affecte negativement la demande et le prix des produits du groupe
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "Changes made by platform operators, including decreasing referrals, the incorporation of AI engines with different algorithms and changes impacting visibility, occur frequently, are outside the Company's control and have adversely affected, and could adversely affect, traffic and engagement for the Company's digital properties and consequently, advertising sales and rates."
controles.correction_proposee: Le document parle de trafic, engagement, ventes publicitaires et tarifs, pas de "demande et prix des produits" en general. Formulation acceptable mais a resserrer.

controles.affirmation: Le 10-K identifie l'usage non autorise de contenu par des applications d'intelligence artificielle GENERATIVE comme une menace directe sur les revenus de propriete intellectuelle, notamment les revenus de licences
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "Unauthorized use, including in the digital environment and as a result of advances in AI, presents a threat to revenues from products and services based on intellectual property." Le mot "generative" n'apparait AUCUNE fois dans le 10-K FY2026 (0 occurrence).
controles.correction_proposee: Le document ecrit "advances in AI", pas "generative AI", et vise les "revenues from products and services based on intellectual property", sans citer specifiquement les revenus de licences. Remplacer "applications d'intelligence artificielle generative" par "progres de l'intelligence artificielle" et supprimer "notamment les revenus de licences".

controles.affirmation: Book Publishing fait face a la concurrence de plateformes d'IA generative emergentes sur le marche du livre
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026, passage concurrence de Book Publishing : "competes with other large publishers, such as Penguin Random House, Simon & Schuster, Hachette Livre and Macmillan, as well as with numerous smaller publishers [...] competition could also come from new entrants as barriers to entry in book publishing are low. In addition, HarperCollins competes for consumers with other media formats and sources such as movies, television programming, magazines and mobile content."
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune mention d'IA, generative ou non, dans le paragraphe concurrentiel de Book Publishing. Supprimer cette affirmation ou la remplacer par la concurrence citee par le document : nouveaux entrants (barrieres a l'entree faibles) et autres formats de media.

controles.affirmation: Revenus digitaux a 76% des revenus de circulation de Dow Jones en 2026 contre 74% en 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "Digital revenues represented 76% of circulation revenue for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, as compared to 74% for fiscal 2025."

controles.affirmation: 2,0 Mds $ d'emprunts contre 2,1 Mds $ de tresorerie, dont 255 M$ non librement accessibles car loges chez REA Group detenue a 62%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "Total borrowings 1,989 1,962" ; "Cash and cash equivalents $2,095 $2,403" ; "includes $255 million and $280 million, respectively, which is not readily accessible by the Company as it is held by REA Group Limited" ; "the Company's 62.0% interest in REA Group"

controles.affirmation: Baisse du resultat net de 573 M$ vs 1 180 M$ (-51%) expliquee par un gain unique de 692 M$ enregistre en 2025 lors de la cession de Foxtel
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : "Net income attributable to News Corporation stockholders $573 $1,180 $(607) (51)%" ; "Net income from discontinued operations, net of tax for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 was nil compared to $692 million for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025" ; "For fiscal 2025, Other, net primarily consists of the $716 million pre-tax gain on the sale of Foxtel."
controles.correction_proposee: Les 692 M$ sont le resultat net total des activites abandonnees de l'exercice 2025, pas le gain de cession. Le gain sur la vente de Foxtel etait de 716 M$ avant impot. Ecrire "692 M$ de resultat net d'activites abandonnees en 2025, dont un gain de cession de Foxtel de 716 M$ avant impot".
